audit.whatIsWrong: Orianna was called 'he/his' throughout, and the difficulty was framed around dodging her as a champion rather than around the ball, which is where every one of her abilities actually originates.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists orianna as female. Command: Attack fires 815 units from the ball's position, not hers ('Her Ball remains at the target location after'), Command: Dissonance pulses 225 around the ball, and Command: Shockwave launches enemies within 410 of the ball toward it. Her threat range is ball position plus range, which is why 'she out-ranges you' felt true even though her Q range (815) is shorter than your Q (900).
audit.corrected: Difficulty rewritten around ball position: track the ball as a second enemy, trade when it is behind her, and treat a forward ball as the real range marker.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike table had no numbers and one internal contradiction: whys[5] said her first item lets her 'out-value your early lead', while win[5] and the packet levelChart both say Aurora wins the first-item stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Orianna, Orianna, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Orianna] and content win[] matches it exactly, so row 5 belongs to Aurora and the sentence under it was arguing the opposite. Her R is 110/95/80 at 410 radius, her E shields on a flat 9s, and her Q drops from 7s to 3s by rank 5 — those are the spikes worth naming.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[2].text rewritten to the first-item window Aurora actually owns: Luden's makes the Q-E-Q rotation land faster than a 9s Command: Protect returns. Late-game rows left with Orianna, which both layers and the packet agree on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one interaction that decides this lane — Command: Protect eating your burst — appeared nowhere on the page, and spikes[0].text used a fabricated Aurora ability name, 'Q Twin Drift'. wants.foe[0] also credited the poke to Command: Dissonance.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst. Command: Protect is a flat 9s cooldown, shields, adds armour and MR, and damages enemies the ball passes through on its way — the shortest-cooldown shield you will trade into. Command: Dissonance is a 225-radius pulse, not a poke tool; the poke is Command: Attack at 815. 'Twin Drift' matches nothing in the kit file.
audit.corrected: The 9s shield is now the stated commit condition in winCon, breakdown.carry, whys[3], whys[5], spikes[0].text and spikes[2].text. The fabricated name was removed rather than replaced — the kit file carries no Aurora ability names, so the slot letter and the real 900 range were used instead. wants.foe[0] now credits Command: Attack.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all — defect-catalogue item 3.
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: R 110/95/80 at 410 radius, E every 9s, Q 7s at rank 1 down to 3s at rank 5, your W 22s. The Q's rank-5 cooldown is worth stating because a 3-second poke tool changes how much a 'cooldown window' is worth late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four bullets were copy-paste bleed: dosFull[0].d (ball tracking under a 'trade Q-E-Q patterns' title), dosFull[1].d (tradeGood under a spirit-haste title), dontsFull[1].d (the W-as-exit line under 'Poke without the recast planned') and dontsFull[2].d (tradeBad under 'Stand in his rotation during E cooldown').
audit.why: Defect-catalogue item 2 — the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: All four bodies rewritten to answer their own titles, grounded in the ball, the 9s shield, the 225 slow field and the Q recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: LEVEL CHART DISAGREEMENT. phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[] reads [Orianna, Orianna, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Orianna] — seven rows rendering two different answers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches win[] exactly, so the content layer and the packet agree and only phases[N].side dissents. The kit supports the shape: her Q at 35 mana on 7s owns levels 1-2, your full kit at 3 owns the middle, and a 410-radius launch into her team owns the late game.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side proposed as one atomic group to match win[]. phases[0].why, phases[1].why and phases[6].why are rewritten in the SAME proposal because those three rows now belong to Orianna and their old text described Aurora winning. Rows 2-5 keep their existing why, which already reads Aurora-favouring.

notes: CHART: phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[] reads [Orianna, Orianna, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Orianna] — and packet.levelChart matches win[] exactly. Resolved toward win[]/packet, proposed as one atomic group. Because rows 0, 1 and 6 now belong to Orianna, I rewrote phases[0].why, phases[1].why and phases[6].why in the SAME proposal so no row argues with the sentence under it. Rows 2-5 keep their existing why, which already reads Aurora-favouring. Ratings were deliberately left untouched — I had no grounded basis to move a number, and moving one on a guess is worse than leaving it. INTERNAL CONTRADICTION FIXED: content whys[5] said Orianna out-values your lead at first item while win[5] said Aurora — the sentence contradicted its own row. Rewritten Aurora-favouring on the 9s shield window. THE CENTRAL MECHANIC WAS MISSING: nothing on the page said that every Orianna ability originates from the ball, not from Orianna. Her Q travels 815 from the ball's resting position, her W pulses 225 around it, and her R launches everyone within 410 of it toward it. That is why 'she out-ranges you' reads true even though her Q range (815) is shorter than your Q (900). It is now the tldr and the cooldown field. SHIELD INTERACTION ADDED: Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield with armour and MR attached, and the missing-interactions file flagged it. It is now the stated commit condition in six places. FABRICATION KILLED: spikes[0].text used 'Q Twin Drift' for Aurora's Q. Removed, not replaced with a guess — the kit file has no Aurora ability names. This is the third matchup in my slice carrying that same invented name, so it is almost certainly across the whole aurora file and worth a global sweep. SELF-CAST NOT ASSERTED: Riot's text for Command: Protect says 'attach to an allied champion'. Whether she can shield herself is not in the text, so nothing on the page now claims she can or cannot — the advice is written as 'force the shield out', which holds either way.
